name: xpostplate
description: Render or fabricate an X post as a PNG: a broadcast plate, a timeline row, an opened post, or a quote.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node --check bin/xpostplate.js && node --input-type=module -e "import {accessSync} from 'node:fs'; for (const f of ['bin/xpostplate.js','lib/args.js','lib/png.js','lib/post.js','lib/svg.js','assets/x-logo.svg','fixtures/sample-post.json']) accessSync(f)"
